stemMd: In an oblique cabinet drawing, the front face is drawn in true shape and receding lengths are drawn at half scale. A depth of 80 cm uses a front-face scale of 1:20. How long is its receding edge on the drawing?
explanationMd: At 1:20, eighty centimetres corresponds to four centimetres. Cabinet convention halves this receding length, producing two centimetres. The stated convention avoids relying on an unspecified oblique scale.

distractorRationale.c: This applies the front-face scale without cabinet depth reduction.
distractorRationale.d: This uses the wrong scale and omits the halving.
distractorRationale.e: This halves the receding length twice.
distractorRationale.a: This halves the real length without the drawing scale.
